rule: the modes the explorer's picker offers, in the order it shows them. The 17 named here are frozen: the roster is neither widened nor narrowed by a bake. It began as the engine's production roster as it stood on 2026-08-23 — the engine gained `tail_itinerary` afterwards, and a bake that read `every production mode` out of the catalog next door would have put a nineteenth mode in front of a reader without anybody deciding to — and on 2026-09-04 a mode this site retired was struck from it, which is the same edit made in the other direction and for the same reason. Presence is the offer — unlike `palettes.jsonl`, there is no unoffered half, because a mode the picker does not list is a mode no link and no figure of this site names. `python -m builder explorer` bakes `catalog.js` from these names, taking each mode's identity line and its curve from the engine catalog, and `builder check`'s bake check holds the committed module to being byte for byte what that produces. `permalink.js`'s own typed MODES is the third copy and is held equal to the baked one by permalink.test.mjs, so moving the picker's roster either way is an edit to this record and to that contract, both made on purpose.
